assumptions: Use precisely the stored graph filtration: M has (q,T)=(1,1), W_d has (d,d-1), and a derivative adds (1,0).
At fixed q=n, F_(n-1) is spanned by monomials containing a W or a positive jet. Quotienting by them leaves only M.
Set W and all positive jets to zero in the original homogeneous graph/Jacobian presentation. The diagonal algebra is QQ[M]/(I_d(M), partial P/partial M_a).
This uses the full original quotient, not just initial terms of the defining relations. Differential consequences vanish after setting all positive jets to zero.
provenance.proof: Every potential monomial contains at least two Casimir factors. Its gradient belongs to the Casimir ideal. Thus the diagonal quotient is exactly the nilpotent-cone ring. The regular sequence of basic invariants gives its exact rational Hilbert series.
provenance.scope: Exact HL diagonal of the stated graph model through the jump; no full Macdonald coefficient or Schur-specialization computation is supplied by this proof.
